graph_eda.analysis_caveat: Typed graph density cannot be interpreted like an all-to-all social network; 16 orphaned Place nodes missing recommendation paths.

structural_acceptance.limitation: Labels chosen by researcher from the SAME candidate source graph; this is deterministic structural acceptance, not independent preference accuracy or measured network uplift.

model_sensitivity.caveat: Designed uncertainty scenarios; no observed real-world travel-time distribution.

graph_link_holdout.methodology: Deity-Place edge hidden prior to all scoring; rank all unseen places except training neighbors; fixed six random trials
graph_link_holdout.warning: This diagnoses topology-based hidden-edge recovery, not user relevance. True edges are still unverified source beliefs; no independence from input corpus.

signature_trip.algorithm: Offline fixed-catalog design from prior v1 weighted PPR + Dijkstra + restricted candidate orienteering
signature_trip.baseline_issue: Custom objective is same as optimizer target; not an independent efficacy metric.
signature_trip.live_gate: Unverified venue hours / pedestrian coordinates / guide capacity / commercial price.
